measured_siblings.summary: Material Handler Agent semiconductor facility SOPs: ESD wrist strap <1 megaohm verification before ESDS handling; 50-pound cart load limit; update inventory management system (IMS) BEFORE physical movement; 10-minute UV sanitization cycle between cleanroom zones (Class 100 vs Class 10,000); return MSL lots to bake-out oven within 15 minutes of dry bag seal breach; continuous visual escort for lots valued over $500,000; one lot at a time single-lot-per-trip rule
